_note: Training sentences for NLI-8 (fine-tuning the checker). Drafted by Claude 2026-10-07, to be reviewed by the founder. Every sentence must be something a real caller would plausibly say at the start of a 119 call. 'expected' = happening now (teaches entailment); 'denied' = explicitly ruled out or in the past (teaches contradiction); the training script adds lookalike symptoms as neutral. Same label rules as the test sets: a symptom that STOPPED during this emergency still counts if it has a 'has stopped' form (vomiting, seizure, heavy_bleeding, choking). Checked by benchmark/check_overlap.py against the 52, the probe, the dev set and test2. NEVER used for testing.
